principle: Earned rank, current billet, and current command span are separate durable facts. Numerical 2,000-9,000 grades recognize independent command scale; casualties alter span, reassignment alters billet, and only an explicit promotion or demotion alters rank.
non_ladder_grades: Marshal of the Four Bastion Corps
Deputy Marshal of the Four Bastion Corps

rank_sources.current_baseline: Exact current-state normalization from already-saved role/rank/command evidence; does not itself constitute a promotion event.
rank_sources.runtime_career: A later explicit lawful promotion or demotion recorded through the career-event surface.

promotion_rule: Promotion is an explicit durable grade change. It requires a higher formal grade than the current formal grade and lawful authority/evidence. Assignment to a larger force, temporary command, casualty replacement, or autonomous staffing never silently promotes anybody.
demotion_rule: Demotion is an explicit career consequence with lawful authority and evidence. Losses, smaller current strength, relief from command, illness, transfer, or cadre reserve status never silently demote rank.
relief_rule: Relief removes or changes a billet while preserving durable rank unless a separate explicit demotion is also ordered.
reserve_rule: Reserve/cadre status removes active command span while preserving durable rank and career history.
retirement_rule: Retirement ends active billet/service while preserving rank history. Return to service requires a new lawful billet.
career_evidence_rule: Performance creates evidence and opportunity. It never automatically promotes, demotes, appoints, or relieves anyone.
representation_rule: Aggregate officers keep rank inventory/cadre state inside their formation. A materialized exact person carries the same durable rank separately from billet and span; materialization never grants rank.

army_lifecycle.post_battle_rule: Shattered Units are preserved as organizations/cadres by default. Refill uses conserved trained reserves; merger, dissolution, demotion and detachment require explicit lawful reorganization.
army_lifecycle.promotion_growth_rule: Promotion may create a new Nested Army around an existing Unit, but later staffing attaches only exact physically available direct Units or intact subordinate Nested Armies. Descendants are never flattened or duplicated.
army_lifecycle.casualty_rule: Casualties update strength and may create vacancies or cadre surplus. They do not change surviving officers' durable rank.
army_lifecycle.immediate_staff_review_rule: A single battle causing at least 15% personnel loss to a formation, or destroying it, immediately reviews that formation's exact containing NPC command group. Review may reassign only existing co-located direct parent Units; player-directed hierarchies, durable rank, and recursive Unit identity are untouched.

standing_army_mobilization.principle: A sovereign may permanently reinforce an existing state field army from already-conserved active military reserve when that command is mobilized for war. Rank provides a normal wartime establishment target, not a hard cap or free manpower grant. Reinforcement preserves troop-role provenance, existing formation history, and permanent army identity; it never creates levy/support/engineer/command-support fighting roles.
standing_army_mobilization.permanent_assignment_rule: Personnel transferred from an active sovereign force reserve into a standing army remain assigned after the operation unless a later lawful reorganization transfers or releases them.
standing_army_mobilization.nested_army_rule: Eligible same-state nested field armies are reinforced before their parent so recursive strength is conserved and never double-counted.
standing_army_mobilization.player_rule: Autonomous state mobilization never enlarges a player-directed command; player force growth requires an explicit lawful assignment or recruitment path.
